english.title: Knowingly concerned in evading the prohibition on exportation of a controlled drug of Class B from the United Kingdom
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were knowingly concerned in the

(A)_[exportation]_
(B)_[shipment as stores]_

of goods, namely **(..SPECIFY DRUG..), being a controlled drug of Class B, with intent to evade the prohibition on exportation of controlled drugs imposed by section 3 of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section68(2) and (4) of and Schedule1 to the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order
Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For offence of fraudulent evasion of duty see section 170 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
(ii) See H9585 and H9749 for offences relating to drugs of Classes A and C and H9751 for offence relating to drugs of an unspecified class

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: 6 months imprisonment and/or a penalty of £20,000 or of three times the value of the goods whichever is the greater.
INDICTMENT: 14 years imprisonment and/or a penalty of any amount.

Time Limit on Prosecutions:
Twenty years
